decisions.reason: Distinguishes clipboard draft/occurrence offsets from detect spans, including chip expansion versus one U+FFFC and normal text widths.
Locates snapshot.draft.length in add, explains first empty-composer success and later detect-space overshoot, and rejects the toast as evidence of a real concurrent edit.
Traces unconverted occurrence offset/length to consumeToken, the ignored false result, unconditional record deletion, and the resulting unavailable dock label from the same mismatch.
Derives preceding-chip subtraction for insertion and removal, uses a one-detect-character remove span, keeps revision guards, and gates record deletion on successful consumption.
Proposes repeat paste tests with multiple chips and removal tests preserving other chips, dock records, and transactional behavior.
